registration.method: Orientation-preserving similarity fit from 29 corresponding right bone bounding-box centers; independently checked by a deterministic held-out split and bidirectional vertex-to-triangle surface distances.
registration.matrixConvention: column-major; maps Three.js FBXLoader world coordinates to BodyParts3D source millimeters
